    关于申请贵州师范大学2026/2027学年“丝绸之路”中国政府奖学金项目的通知

    2026年04月29日 09:49 　作者：谯雁 　责任编辑：彭万斌　点击：[]


    贵州师范大学2026/2027学年“丝绸之路”中国政府奖学金项目用于自主招收来自共建“一带一路”国家的优秀国际学生到校学习，现将申请的有关事项通知如下：

    一、申请条件

    1.来自越南、老挝、泰国、缅甸、俄罗斯、乌干达等“一带一路”国家的非中国籍公民，身心健康。

    2.品行端正、无违法犯罪和不良行为记录。

    3.中文水平需达到中文水平考试（HSK）四级及以上。

    4.具有学士学位，学习成绩优秀，年龄一般不超过35周岁。

    二、资助类别及授课语言

    1.资助类别：旅游管理专业硕士研究生

    2.授课语言：中文

    三、资助内容和标准

    1.学费：资助标准参照现行中国政府奖学金标准执行。

    2.住宿费：为奖学金生提供免费宿舍，一般为2-3人间。

    3.生活费：由学校按月发放；发放标准参照现行中国政府奖学金标准执行。

    4.综合医疗保险：按照国家有关规定，为奖学金生购买医疗保险。

    四、申请途径和时间

    1.申请途径

    申请者访问“留学中国”网站，点击“中国政府奖学金来华留学管理信息系统”进入申请系统。“留学中国”网站链接：https://studyinchina.csc.edu.cn/#/register ，注册账户成功后登录系统进行申请。


    2.申请时间

    2026年4月29日-2026年5月25日。

    注：贵州师范大学“受理机构编号”为10663，“留学项目种类”请选择“B类”

    五、联系方式

    联系人：柳老师

    联系电话：86-851-86759517

    邮箱：lxs@gznu.edu.cn



    Notice on Application for the GZNU 2026/2027 Academic Year

    Silk Road Program of Chinese Government Scholarship


    GZNU 2026/2027 “Silk Road Program” of Chinese Government Scholarship is designed to recruit outstanding international students from countries participating in the Belt and Road Initiative to pursue studies at Guizhou Normal University. The relevant application details are hereby announced as follows:


    I. Eligibility

    1. Applicants must be non-Chinese citizens from Belt and Road partner countries, including but not limited to Vietnam, Laos, Thailand, Myanmar, Russia, Uganda, and be in good physical and mental health;


    2. Applicants must demonstrate good moral character and have no record of criminal or improper conduct;


    3. Applicants must have achieved HSK Level 4 or above;


    4. Applicants must hold a bachelor’s degree, have an excellent academic record, and generally be under the age of 35.


    II. Scholarship Category and Language of Instruction

    1. Scholarship Category: Master’s Program in Tourism Management


    2. Language of Instruction: Chinese


    III. Scholarship Coverage and Standards

    1. Tuition: Covered in accordance with the prevailing standards of the Chinese Government Scholarship;


    2. Accommodation: Free on-campus accommodation will be provided, typically in shared rooms for 2–3 students;


    3. Living Allowance: Provided monthly by the University in accordance with the prevailing Chinese Government Scholarship standards;


    4. Comprehensive Medical Insurance: Provided in accordance with relevant national regulations.


    IV. Application Procedures and Timeline

    1. Application Method


    Applicants should visit the Study in China website, click “CGS Information Management System for International Students”, and complete the online application procedure. Applicants are required to to submit application online.


    Website: https://studyinchina.csc.edu.cn/#/register


    Applicants are required to register an account and log in to submit their application online.


    2. Application Period


    April 29, 2026 – May 25, 2026


    The Agency Number of Guizhou Normal University is 10663, and the Silk Road Program is Type B.


    V. Contact Information

    Contact：Ms. Liu


    Tel：86-851-86759517


    Email：lxs@gznu.edu.cn
